newsitem.title: JAPAN: Vitec shares ask-only after probe report.
newsitem.headline: Vitec shares ask-only after probe report.

text.p: Shares in semiconductor trading firm Vitec Co Ltd were ask-only in early Wednesday afternoon trade after a news report that a securities watchdog had begun an insider trading probe involving Vitec.
The share was ask-only at 1,120 yen at 0342 GMT, against Tuesday's closing price of 1,140 yen.

A Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) official said the watchdog could not comment on the NHK television report that a senior Vitec executive was the subject of an SESC investigation into possible insider trading. Officials at Vitec were not immediately available for comment.
NHK said the investigation concerned the buying of shares in Shintom Co Ltd shortly before the company made a third-party allocation of shares in August 1994 with the aim of raising its capital.
Shintom, an audio-visual equipment maker, said it could not immediately make any comment on the reported investigation.
